caveats: If one sample has a library size several times below the median of the study, do not delete it in silence. Keep it through the sample structure QC, look at it on the PCA and on the sample distance heatmap, report its library size and its detected genes beside the others, and remove it only with a stated reason. The count models down-weight a low-depth sample through its size factor, thus removal is a judgment, not a default.
With n = 12 and 12000 genes, PC1 may be dominated by depth rather than condition; report the correlation between PC1 and log library size so a depth-driven axis is not mistaken for biology.
The Salmon import state is unknown, so a length-correction artefact cannot be excluded; a blind VST and a distance matrix are robust enough for QC but this limitation belongs in the report.

steps.description: Load counts.csv and metadata.csv, check that the 12 metadata sample identifiers match the 12 count columns exactly (report any mismatch or reordering rather than silently reindexing), and build a DESeqDataSet with design ~ condition used only to hold the metadata. Report a per-sample table of total library size (column sum), detected genes (count > 0), fraction of counts in the top 10 and top 100 genes, and the DESeq2 size factor. Apply the variance stabilizing transformation blind to the design (blind = TRUE), compute a PCA on the 500 genes with the highest variance after transformation, and draw a heatmap of the Euclidean distances between samples on the transformed values. Colour PCA and heatmap by condition and label every point with its sample identifier. Report the percent variance on PC1 and PC2 and a hierarchical clustering of the distance matrix. Keep all 12 samples; do not filter or remove any sample in this step. If the count matrix holds non-integer values (a sign of a length-corrected import), round for the DESeqDataSet and record that this was done.

steps.description: Using the artefacts from T1S1, assemble the evidence on sample_01 and issue a recommendation with a stated reason. Report: (1) its library size and detected-gene count as a ratio to the median of the other 11 samples, and its DESeq2 size factor against the range of the rest; (2) its position on PC1/PC2 - distance to its own condition centroid versus the mean within-group distance of the other samples of that condition, and whether PC1 correlates with log library size across all 12 samples (Spearman, reported with the coefficient); (3) its mean row in the Euclidean distance matrix versus the mean of the other samples, and whether it forms a singleton branch in the hierarchical clustering; (4) whether its deviation is depth-shaped - i.e. it loses low-expressed genes and its detection rate versus depth follows the same curve as the others, consistent with undersampling - or condition-shaped, showing a distinct expression pattern in well-detected genes. Compute a leave-one-out check: recompute the VST and PCA without sample_01 and report whether the grouping of the remaining 11 by condition changes materially. Conclude with one of three verdicts: keep (depth is carried by the size factor), keep with caution (usable but note reduced power and possible loss of low-count genes), or exclude (with the specific reason and the numbers behind it). Do not fit any differential expression model.
acceptance_criteria: Sample_01's library size, detected genes, and size factor are reported as ratios to the other 11 samples
Its PCA distance to its own condition centroid is compared quantitatively to the within-group spread of the other samples of that condition
The Spearman correlation between PC1 and log library size across all 12 samples is reported
A leave-one-out VST + PCA without sample_01 is run and the effect on the condition grouping of the remaining 11 samples is stated

A single explicit verdict is issued - keep, keep with caution, or exclude - with the numeric evidence and the reason stated, and with the counterfactual (what changes downstream if the opposite choice is made)
No differential expression test is fitted

plan.title: AD lesional vs control: sample-structure QC
plan.analytical_narrative:
The question stops at sample structure: how the twelve skin samples look before any test is fitted, plus a verdict on the shallow sample. The inputs are a 12000 x 13 gene-level count CSV from Salmon (counts.csv, first column gene IDs, 12 sample columns) and a 12 x 2 sample table (metadata.csv, one row per sample with condition), 6 atopic dermatitis lesional vs 6 control, unpaired, single batch. The profile flags sample_01 at roughly 4x below the median library size.

One QC track, split into two steps so each fits a single sandbox invocation and so the depth verdict is argued rather than asserted. T1S1 builds a DESeqDataSet from the raw counts and the metadata (verifying that the 12 metadata rows align to the 12 count columns), reports per-sample library size and detected-gene counts, applies the variance stabilizing transformation blind to the design, computes a PCA on the 500 most variable genes, and draws the Euclidean sample-to-sample distance heatmap, coloured by condition. T1S2 then focuses on sample_01: where it sits on PC1/PC2 and in the distance matrix relative to its own condition group, whether its detected-gene count and its count-depth relationship (mean-variance / detection-rate versus depth) look like a depth artefact rather than a distinct biology, and whether the size factor DESeq2 estimates for it is within the range the model can carry.

The count import state is unknown - the record does not say whether a Salmon length correction was applied - so the QC treats the matrix as the counts as delivered, rounds non-integer values only if present, and states that assumption in the report. That ambiguity affects a downstream model far more than it affects a blind VST and a distance matrix, so it is recorded, not resolved here. No differential expression, no enrichment: the question did not ask for a test, and a low-depth sample is kept and reported per the QC procedure, not silently dropped. The verdict is a recommendation with a stated reason, not an automatic exclusion.

steps.method: blind VST, PCA on top variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library size summary
